title: The Ice Breaks
offer: Hear that crack? The ice breaks: spring is here again! Row out and hail two boats: ask how everybody got through the winter.

says: A long winter! But the herring kept, thanks to your salt.
steps.say: Everybody is well! But Tova has asked for you all winter. Row to Laxön!
There you are! Spring is when the animals need us most. Will you be my apprentices, and learn to heal?

fact: When the ice broke in spring, the boats came out, and with them the news.
